tldr: Black Moon Lilith transiting the 10th house: autonomy and the disowned self activate through career, reputation, authority, public standing, and legacy.
body: Black Moon Lilith moving through the 10th house can activate the disowned, uncompromising self through career, reputation, authority, public standing, and legacy. For roughly nine months, this transit may expose where shame, control, compliance, or refusal has gathered in this part of life. You refuse to be controlled in public life; raw ambition that will not play the expected role. Needs unconventional, self-directed work and resists rigid authority; may go marginal or self-employed. Originality is an asset in creative fields, a liability in rigid ones.
business: The disowned self activates through career, reputation, authority, public standing, and legacy. Authority claimed on your own terms, often as an outsider.
shadow: Self-sabotage of reputation, or a combative public face.
advice: Reclaim autonomy in the 10th house without letting reaction make the decision for you. Work with career, reputation, authority, public standing, and legacy directly and consciously.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Black Moon Lilith house placement material.
